name: New York
summary: The state coat of arms on dark blue: Liberty and Justice flanking a shield showing the sun rising over the Hudson River, with an eagle on a globe above and the motto 'Excelsior' (Ever upward).
origin: The arms date from 1778, and the flag in its current form was adopted in 1901. In 2020 the seal was updated to add 'E Pluribus Unum' beneath the shield.

symbols.name: Liberty and Justice
symbols.description: Liberty with a Phrygian cap and a crown at her feet; Justice blindfolded with scales and sword.
symbols.meaning: Freedom from British rule (the discarded crown) and impartial law.

symbols.name: Sun over the Hudson
symbols.description: A sun rising behind mountains over a river with sailing ships.

symbols.name: Eagle on a globe
symbols.description: An eagle on a globe showing the Atlantic.
symbols.meaning: New York's place in the world.

facts: 'Excelsior' is New York's motto, meaning 'Ever upward'.
New York City has its own blue, white and orange flag based on Dutch colours.
The crown at Liberty's feet represents independence from Britain.
clues: A coat of arms with Liberty and Justice and a sun rising over a river, on blue.
A crown lies discarded at one figure's feet.
